notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 88–452, title VII, § 745, formerly § 744(b), as added Pub. L. 93–644, § 10(a), Jan. 4, 1975, 88 Stat. 2322; renumbered § 745 and amended Pub. L. 94–341, § 2(b)(15), (17)(C), July 6, 1976, 90 Stat. 806, set forth provisions relating to report by Director on availability and effectiveness of Federal agency programs.
